_comment: Patch notes shown in the app's What's New dialog. This file is bundled into the exe. CHANGELOG.md is the human-readable source of truth; keep the two in step when a release is cut. Newest version first.

en.headline: Settings and update checking
notes: New Settings window, reached from the Settings button in the top-right corner. It shows which version you have installed.
You can now check for updates yourself. The app asks the release server whether a newer version exists, and if there is one it shows you what changed and offers a link to download it.
Release notes appear in whichever language you are using the app in.
Update checks never interrupt your work. If there is no internet connection, or the network blocks the release server, the app simply tells you it could not check.
This version does not check for updates by itself - you start the check from the Settings window.

zh.headline: 设置与更新检查
notes: 新增“设置”窗口，可通过右上角的“设置”按钮打开，其中会显示当前已安装的版本。
现在可以手动检查更新。软件会向发布服务器查询是否有新版本；如有，会显示更新内容并提供下载链接。
更新说明会以您当前使用的界面语言显示。
检查更新不会中断您的工作。如果没有网络连接，或网络无法访问发布服务器，软件只会提示无法检查。
此版本不会自动检查更新，需要您在“设置”窗口中手动开始检查。

en.headline: First beta release
notes: Version numbering restarts at 0.1.0. The earlier internal builds were labelled 1.0; no features were removed, the beta simply gets an honest number. The app is now called Unitrans Portal.
Sort waybill PDFs into the same order as the Excel workbook, with a SHA-256 verification that every sorted file is a byte-for-byte copy of the original download.
Create one bulk PDF for printing, with optional separator pages between waybills and digital sequence marks on forms 1 and 4.
Fill blank driver numbers from scanned waybill images.
Unlock PDFs that open but are blocked from editing or printing by permissions-style encryption.
The application now carries a proper icon and version information, so Windows shows which build is installed instead of leaving it blank.

zh.headline: 首个测试版本
notes: 版本号从 0.1.0 重新开始。之前的内部版本标记为 1.0；没有移除任何功能，只是为测试版使用了准确的版本号。软件名称现为 Unitrans Portal。
按 Excel 工作表的顺序整理运单 PDF，并使用 SHA-256 校验每个文件与原始下载完全一致。
可生成用于打印的合并 PDF，并可选在运单之间插入分隔页、在单据 1 和 4 上标注序列号。
从扫描的运单图片中自动填写空白的司机车号。
解锁可以打开但受权限加密限制无法编辑或打印的 PDF。
软件现在带有正式图标和版本信息，Windows 中可直接查看已安装的版本。
